notes.title: T-Shirts, Rate/Recommend, Ver 1.2, and...
notes.content: [h1]Swag![/h1][p]You wanted swag, we made swag![/p][p]YUP, we got your upper body covered! [b][url="https://talechaser.games/shop/"]OmOneko shirts[/url][/b] are purrrrfect for wearing to a convention, gaming night, or just sitting around reading visual novels! [/p][p]Profits go to buying shirts for the dev team so they don't have to buy their own.[/p][p][/p][h1]Recommend & Review![/h1][p]We get a lot of [/p][list][*][p][i]Why is this free? Why aren't you charging $ for it?[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Why aren't you wearing pants?[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]Well, we didn't make this for the cash, we made it to tell the character's stories and bring their world to life. [b]The best way to "contribute"[/b] and help us out[b] is simply to Recommend/Rate/Review OmOneko on Steam, JAST, Itch.io, VNDB, IGDB, MetaCritic, Reddit,[/b][/p][p](Wanna be a hero: make a YouTube game review, post on IGN Forum, PC Gamer Forums, Game Rant Threads, Giant Bomb Forums, GameFAQs boards, NeoGAF, ResetEra...) [/p][p][b]and/or your own social media![/b][/p][p]We can't stress how much even a few positive words really help[/p][p](and makes the devs feel like all the effort is worthwhile!)[/p][p][strike]No, we have no plans to wear pants. Stop asking.[/strike][/p][p][/p][h1]Oopsie-poopsie![/h1][p][b]New update:  1.2[/b][/p][p]- We tweaked the Steam Achievements code since we found a very small issue where an unusual set of circumstances caused an achievements to fail to trigger. Failsafe added.[/p][p]- Fixed the .exe and tray icons[/p][p]- Minor copy edits.[/p][p]- improved presplash loading.[/p][p][/p][h1]and...[/h1][p][b]​Android build[/b] (planning to make available free on itchio and Google Play store) is in final testing![/p][p]If all goes well, it should be available in the next month or so...[/p]

notes.title: ver 1.1 - New Library Update! and...
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470388/aca9ab64d60d7cfa2c24fa0d7e6a1c42538e9046.png[/img]
[h1]First: THANK YOU![/h1]
[b]Thank you[/b] for downloading and playing our game. [b]Thank you[/b] for spending time with Shimi, Pepper, Clawdia, Goro, Veronika, the Waitress, and everyone else in the world we crafted for you. [b]Thank you[/b] for recommending OmOneko to others!! 
[b]Thank you[/b] for your ratings and reviews and letting us know what you think of the strange world of OmOneko!

OmOneko has been seen by nearly 1000 people (combining the Steam and Itchio numbers), and the things you've told us have really made the journey worthwhile. Your feedback has been incredible. 
[b]Thank You![/b]

[h1]Next: BONUS New Library Update [/h1]
A few punctuation and spelling fixes that snuck past all the editing and playtesting is a GREAT excuse for us to add a little bit of scope creep! We've updated the Extras -> Library from a list to a gallery with images:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470388/44f073b83f1ec1f834cd30876a8e77cbfdd59922.png[/img]
Neat, eh?

[h1]Finally: More to come... [/h1]
Yes, we are working on the... "big  something"  for you!
(won't say more, don't want to spoil)

Again, thank you for spending time with us!
(If you want to spend more time with us, we have a very mellow [url=https://discord.gg/kr5j5ay4sq]Discord[/url].)
